title: Uniqueness of non-exhausted window runs
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{upd}$ update an auxiliary value from an optional Boolean symbol, and let $N,N'\in\mathbb{N}$. For every configuration $c$ and auxiliary value $\tau$, if the windowed runs with clock bounds $N$ and $N'$ both report an outcome other than exhaustion, their returned outcome, configuration, and auxiliary value are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols
An update function on auxiliary values and optional Boolean symbols
The run with bound $N$ does not report exhaustion
The run with bound $N'$ does not report exhaustion
